That removes the old top-level default-package structure and makes the codebase easier to grow.

I also centralized slice validation and semantics in [sorting/IndexRange.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/035_insertion_sort/sorting/IndexRange.java:1), so `InsertionSort` no longer mixes algorithm logic with raw range checks.
